items.title: Wallet GUID fact identity can exceed accepted Statistics identifier limit
items.evidence: Imported from archived full Review review-tf0003-arch-01 at 93954850; eng-tf0003-review-rework-07 verified a shared server-owned WalletStatisticsContract and 35-rejects/36-accepts regression on current revision.

items.title: Statistics config budget omits declared EventId dedupe ledger capacity
items.evidence: Imported from archived full Review review-tf0003-verify-02 at 93954850; eng-tf0003-review-rework-07 verified full exact-ledger aggregate budgeting, safe 16x64 defaults, conditional hard caps, and rejection regression on current revision.

items.title: README initialization diagrams drift from canonical manifests
items.evidence: Imported from archived full Review review-tf0003-arch-01 at 93954850; eng-tf0003-review-rework-07 verified README diagrams against both canonical manifests on current revision.

items.title: AutoSave requested-save bookkeeping lacks controller unregistration
items.evidence: Imported from archived full Review review-tf0003-verify-02 at 93954850; eng-tf0003-review-rework-07 verified idempotent unregister cleanup and pending-generation regression on current revision.

items.title: Cycle-unsafe Wallet committed-change copy can escape after authoritative commit
items.evidence: eng-tf0003-convergence-clean-08: Wallet _deliverCommitted deep-copied arbitrary Metadata outside the protected handler call, so cyclic metadata could throw after balance/sequence commit and before Statistics/dirty/signal/network delivery.

items.title: New dedupe source-cap rejection lacks bounded diagnostic
items.evidence: eng-tf0003-convergence-clean-08: DedupeLimitExceeded at max source count returned without the cooldown-bounded payload-free diagnostic required by NFR-019, unlike the event-ledger-full path.

items.title: Dedupe capacity evidence drifted from approved revision-2 policy
items.evidence: eng-tf0003-convergence-clean-08: Teleport Statistics fixture bypassed codec with impossible 32x512 limits and runtime regressions did not cover EventId/source-cap atomic rejection.

items.title: StatisticCollection handoff and worklog are stale
items.evidence: eng-tf0003-convergence-clean-08: feature handoff/worklog retained old suite counts, pre-review/spec-r2 state, and a publish-next wording not authorized by the external-mutation boundary.

items.title: Statistics Run mutates restored lifecycle state during rollback
items.evidence: review-tf0003-arch-10: MementoTransaction rollback restores the previous Statistics memento then calls Run, whose unconditional Session/Place close/recreate mutates the restored state while the transaction reports rollback success.

items.title: Accepted zero save cooldown disables anti-spam coalescing
items.evidence: review-tf0003-arch-10: StatisticsConfigCodec accepts saveRequestCooldownSeconds=0 and Statistics forwards it to AutoSave RequestSave, allowing each SaveSnapshot to schedule a persistence write rather than the required shared coalescing policy.

items.title: Pending teleport-session mismatch lacks bounded diagnostic
items.evidence: review-tf0003-arch-10: Run finalizes mismatched PendingSession and starts a new Session without the rate-limited privacy-safe handoff diagnostic required by PRD-NFR-019.

items.title: README miscounts mandatory Experience Config values
items.evidence: Both review-tf0003-arch-10 and review-tf0003-verify-11: README lists wallet_config, global_save_config, and statistics_config but then refers to both values.

items.title: Retention decrease can make existing profiles unloadable
items.evidence: review-tf0003-verify-11: Reconcile preserves history longer than a newly reduced configured retention while Validate rejects it, so a previously valid persisted profile can fail every load after config generation change.

items.title: Coverage manifest overstates composed failure-path protection
items.evidence: review-tf0003-verify-11: no cross-generation retention regression and AC-010/030/035/039 citations rely on direct-call or generic tests that do not prove required composed rate, handoff, final-fact, fail-closed, and diagnostic behavior.

items.title: Retention zero drops closed snapshots without bounded diagnostic
items.evidence: eng-tf0003-review-rework-12: retention=0 intentionally discards every closed snapshot but the common close path emitted no cooldown-bounded privacy-safe RetentionEvicted diagnostic required by PRD-NFR-019.

items.title: Retention reconciliation can prune an ordering violation before validation
items.evidence: review-tf0003-verify-15: _canTrimHistory does not verify strict creation order before retention pruning; corrupt [SnapshotId 2, SnapshotId 1] at retention 1 becomes [1] and passes later validation, hiding corruption and retaining the older snapshot.

items.title: InitializationAndSaveSystem documentation miscounts required configs
items.evidence: review-tf0003-arch-14: docs/InitializationAndSaveSystem.md omits statistics_config from the overview and says Both configs although the section and server manifest require three native JSON configs.

items.title: Metadata limit and unsafe-shape coverage is incomplete
items.evidence: review-tf0003-verify-19: AC-027 is marked covered without permanent regressions for required node/aggregate-byte bounds and DataStore-unsafe metatable/mixed/sparse table shapes with complete memento immutability.

items.title: Failure regression does not prove dedup rollback and event suppression
items.evidence: review-tf0003-verify-19: AC-033 is marked covered but the cited multi-snapshot candidate failure lacks a valid FactIdentity and success listener, so it does not prove values/dedup/events/dirty stay unchanged.

items.title: Client metadata allowlist privacy is not exercised
items.evidence: review-tf0003-verify-19: AC-034 is marked covered without request-path assertions for allowlisted versus private metadata on Global, Session, and Place projections.

items.title: Feature handoff points to obsolete verification evidence
items.evidence: review-tf0003-verify-19: StatisticCollection handoff still reports 25/201 and ENG-12 while frozen current evidence is 26/202 and ENG-17.

items.title: New EventId late-rejection retry atomicity lacks regression
items.evidence: review-tf0003-arch-22: existing rollback regression rejects an Ordered identity and only preserves a pre-existing EventId; no permanent test attempts a new valid EventId through late candidate-size rejection and proves exact retry applies once.
